messages.content: Build ai-happy-01 entry: create a happy image as PNG, embed as base64 in main.ts, write /output/entry.png deterministically.
Rendering three candidate images with Python/PIL — dog leap, child fireflies, grandmother ducks. Selecting candidate-a for rubric compliance.
Embedding candidate-a.png as base64 into main.ts via _build-main-ts.py script. Entry size: 159KB TS + 141KB PNG embedded.
Entry ready at state/aihappy01/_entry/. Commit SHA pending. Awaiting competition open at 16:00Z UTC to push and submit.
